title: Blink-182, Korn, A Perfect Circle, Turnstile, The Prodigy to Headline 2027 Sonic Temple Festival
summary: The massive rock festival at Historic Crew Stadium in Columbus, Ohio will take place from May 13-16.
contentText:
The 2027 Sonic Temple Art + Music Festival is headed back to Historic Crew Stadium in Columbus, Ohio from May 13-16 with another packed lineup featuring headliners Blink-182, the Offspring and Turnstile (day one), Iron Maiden, A Perfect Circle and Alice in Chains (day two), Falling in Reverse, A Day to Remember and Beartooth (day three) and Korn, $uicideboy$ and Faith No More (day four).

Among the acts joining Blink on day one are: the All-American Rejects, Knocked Loose, Jimmy Eat World, Switchfoot, Bowling for Soup, Meshuggah, Mastodon, Testament, Sleeping with Sirens and Circa Survive, among others.

Day two headliners Iron Maiden will also get support from Seether, Skid Row, Dirty Honey, A Bullet For My Valentine, the Pretty Reckless, Sleep Theory and Otep, with day three also featuring sets from Underoath, Of Mice and Men, Highly Suspect, Badflower, The Prodigy, Jutes and more.

The final day will also have Korn supported by Hollywood Undead, Insane Clown Posse, Waka Flocka Flame, Ministry, Helmet, Sponge, Primus, Clutch, Soulfly, Snot, Hot Mulligan, 3OH!3 and more.

“Sonic Temple has become one of those special weekends where the whole rock community comes together,” said Danny Wimmer Presents GM Chamie McCurry in a statement. “We build each lineup to celebrate the artists who shaped this music, the bands driving it forward, and the next generation that will define it. There’s incredible energy in rock right now, and Sonic Temple reflects that. Columbus has embraced this festival in a way that means a lot to us, and we’re ready to give fans another unforgettable four days.”

Tickets are available here now.

As always, the fest will feature a number of reunions and special appearances, including metal icons Iron Maiden popping in amid their Run For Your Lives 50th anniversary tour, a rare U.S. Faith No More reunion show, an exclusive Ohio reunion show by Circa Survive, Ghostemane’s return to the stage after five years, the U.S. debut of Her Last Sight, and reunion sets from Forever the Sickest Kids, Palisades, Cute Is What We Aim For, The Color Morale, as well as rare sets from Relient K, Otep and Impending Doom.
